name: Ruuster API
description: Read-only access to engagement on a brokerage's Ruuster-powered sites: listings, leads, agents, the weekly summary, email, traffic and lead-event webhooks. Authenticate with the x-api-key and x-email headers of a brokerage owner or admin, from a server. Documentation: https://help.ruuster.com/api (for AI agents: https://help.ruuster.com/api/llms.txt).
